Chapter 7

Daily use — module by module

Har module ka maqsad, aam kaam step-by-step, aur woh qawaid jo yaad rakhne zaroori hain.

Is chapter ke screenshots Company Owner (owner@northwind.test) ke hain jis ke paas har permission hai. Aap ke role ke mutabiq kuch menus ya buttons nazar nahi aayenge — yeh normal hai (Chapter 5).

Har list page par aik jaisi cheezein

  • Upar right primary button (jaise New employee, New invoice) naya record banata hai.
  • Filters (status, date, branch…) aur search box list ko chhota karte hain; Columns se columns chhupa/dikha sakte hain.
  • Column heading par click se sorting; neeche Rows per page (10/25/50/100) aur page numbers.
  • Row par click karne se detail page ya drawer khulta hai; row ke aakhir mein ⋯ menu mein Edit/Delete jaise actions.
  • Status rang-daar badges mein dikhta hai (Draft, Pending approval, Approved, Paid…).

7.1 Dashboard

Dashboard business ki sehat aik nazar mein dikhata hai. Upar right MTD / 30D / 90D / YTD / 12M se period badlein; topbar ke branch filter se aik branch ka data dekhein.

Table 7.1 — Dashboard widgets
Card / widgetKya batata hai
Revenue, Expenses, Net profitGeneral ledger mein posted amounts, pichle barabar period se muqabla (% change).
Outstanding receivables / payablesCustomers se lena aur suppliers ko dena baqi.
Employees, Active products, Pending approvalsHeadcount, active products, aur aap ke faisle ke muntazir items.
Revenue vs expenses chart, By branchWaqt aur branch ke hisaab se trend.
Recent invoices, Pending approvals, Low stockShortcut lists — "View all" / "Inbox" / "View" se poori list.
Headcount by department, Recent activityHR distribution aur haaliya audit activity.
